title: Technicians at a book signing say the signal is still under study

tellings.quote: one of them says, "I was one of the technicians who was who acquired the signal, and it is the strangest signal we've ever acquired, and it's still under study."

plain: At a book signing in San Antonio, Texas, in the 2010s, a man came up to Whitley Strieber, a writer who says he has met alien beings, and said he was one of the technicians who picked up a certain signal. The man said it was the strangest signal they had ever received and that it was still being studied. Strieber repeats what the technician told him, as a sign that something real was recorded.
